findings.title: Do not authorize comment retry from a single incomplete readback page

evidence.observation: Issue comments request uses comments?per_page=100 without page traversal or completeness metadata.
github_mutation_not_reconciled plus RetryAfterAuthenticatedAbsence dispatches the mutation again.
Only the single response is inspected; lack of exact marker is classified as not reconciled.
Recovery tests use empty synthetic results or unavailable transport; they do not prove complete pagination.

findings.rationale: For an issue with more than 100 comments, a successful newly posted comment can be beyond the first returned page. Initial reconciliation leaves durable intent pending; an explicit authenticated-absence retry sees the same incomplete first page and posts a duplicate. Successful HTTP transport of one page is not proof of absence. Traverse all pages or fail closed as incomplete before permitting retry. This is a current coupled remote operational safety finding; it does not rewrite historical cutover evidence.

V3-F-ac-1.rationale: Assigned crate and CLI/projection surfaces preserve explicit native authority and mapped predecessor contracts; complete #179/#180 artifact mapping is owned by the evidence reviewer.

V3-F-ac-2.rationale: Current operational route parity cannot receive an unqualified pass while authenticated absence recovery can duplicate comments from incomplete readback (R771-ROUTES-1). Local modeled tests do not prove live remote behavior.

V3-F-ac-3.rationale: CLI requires explicit typed rollback operation and retired shadow/soak deny mutation; actual historical rollback exercise and current terminal implementation are separately assigned.

V3-F-ac-4.rationale: Assigned operational dispatch, proof/install and public guidance preserve authenticated canonical native selector authority and explicit typed cutover/rollback boundary; no missing-proof automatic v2 fallback observed in assigned route entrypoints.
